submission_identity.repository_head_rule: Use the exact commit SHA supplied with the submission; run scripts/verify_submission_bundle.py to print the current checkout SHA.

runtime.ocr_failure_policy: abstain; do not invent a workforce value

source_classes.name: Brønnøysundregistrene open data and official account copies
source_classes.role: entity identity, registry facts, roles, group structure, locations, financials and workforce evidence
source_classes.license_or_rights_basis: NLOD 2.0 for BRREG open-data datasets; annual-account copies are fetched from the official BRREG service and only bounded claim evidence/hash metadata are retained in output

source_classes.name: Wikidata structured data
source_classes.role: exact Norwegian organisation-number to official-website candidate nomination only
source_classes.publication_boundary: Wikidata only nominates a candidate; independent company-page identity proof is required before website publication

source_classes.name: Verified company-owned public web pages
source_classes.role: website identity proof, bounded description/contact/social-link evidence
source_classes.acquisition: bounded public HTTP retrieval with safe URL/redirect handling and robots policy
source_classes.license_or_rights_basis: No blanket content-reuse licence is assumed. The system retains source URL, retrieval time, content hash and a bounded factual claim span rather than republishing full pages.
source_classes.publication_boundary: Only exact-company evidence is published; ambiguous or conflicting pages abstain

explicit_non_sources: No independent sentiment model in the production runner
No inferred hiring activity, follower counts, engagement or platform verification
known_limitations: Builderr owns the hidden availability denominator, external union and official score; this repository does not claim that hidden recall, coverage or total-score gates are proven.
Verified company websites, social declarations and contact emails are intentionally narrower than official registry/workforce coverage because publication requires exact-entity evidence.
Annual-report workforce extraction abstains on missing or conflicting company-scope employee/FTE phrases.
A company-declared social URL means only that the exact verified company page declared that URL; the platform page itself is not fetched.
A published contact email means the address was present in retained first-party evidence and matched the verified website registered domain; deliverability is not claimed.
